requirements.claim: The return-code service selects its action from the request type (RC-REQUEST-TYPE): 'I' initialises the return-code area (program ID spaces, current and highest code 0, status SUCCESS, response code 0); 'S' records a new return code; 'G' returns the current code, the highest code and the status with response code 0; 'L' inserts one row into DB2 table RTNCODES with the current timestamp, program ID, current code, highest code, status and message, setting response code 0 when the insert succeeds (SQLCODE 0) and 8 otherwise; 'A' analyses logged codes over a time window. Any other request type performs nothing and leaves the response code unchanged.
requirements.title: Route return-code service requests by request type

requirements.claim: On an analyse request ('A') the system counts the logged return codes in RTNCODES for the requested program ID whose timestamp is greater than or equal to the caller's start time and less than or equal to the caller's end time, and returns the count, the highest (MAX) and the lowest (MIN) logged return code. The response code is 0 when the query succeeds (SQLCODE 0) and 8 otherwise.
requirements.title: Analyse logged return codes for a program within a time window
